2020 Q3.gq: Based on these expectations, we have increased our guidance and we expect the following for the full year 2020; net revenue to be in the range of $3.24 billion to $3.26 billion, adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $715 million to $720 million, adjusted EPS to be in the range of $1.95 to $1.97 per share, and net debt to be approximately $1.9 billion at December 31, 2020.

2021 Q1.gq: As a result, for the second quarter of 2021, we now expect net revenue to grow in the high single digits, adjusted net income to be in the range of $76 million to $83 million, adjusted EPS to be in the range of $0.36 to $0.39, adjusted EBITDA to be in a range of $140 million to $150 million.

2021 Q3.gq: Adjusted net income to be in the range of $93 million to $108 million, adjusted EBITDA to be in the range of $170 million to $190 million and adjusted EPS to be in the range of $0.44 to $0.51.

2022 Q1.gq: Adjusted EPS to be in the range of $0.23 to $0.27 per share.

2022 Q2.gq: And adjusted EPS to be in the range of $0.21 to $0.25 per share.

2026 Q1.gq: Second quarter 2026 net revenues are expected to be minus 2% to plus 1%, compared to second quarter 2025 net revenues of $938 million, benefiting from Foil pricing actions.
2026 Q1.bq: I am pleased with the strong start to the year with results that exceeded our expectations across all key financial metrics, reflecting disciplined execution across all parts of the organization.

2026 Q2.gq: For the third quarter, we expect net revenues to be approximately flat compared to third quarter 2025 net revenues of $931 million.

2026 Q3.gq: We expect fourth quarter net income to be in a range of $101 million to $114 million, with EPS expected in the range of $0.48 to $0.54, and we expect adjusted EBITDA in the range of $196 million to $211 million.
